sql.query: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS UNSIGNED) AS blockerCount,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.taskName ORDER BY p.id SEPARATOR ', ') AS blockerNames FROM tbl_tasks t INNER JOIN tbl_task_dependencies d ON d.taskId=t.id AND d.workflowId=t.workflowId AND d.tenantId=t.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_tasks p ON p.id=d.dependsOnTaskId AND p.workflowId=t.workflowId AND p.tenantId=t.tenantId WHERE t.id=:taskId AND t.workflowId=:workflowId AND t.tenantId=:tenantId AND :requestedStatus NOT IN ('not_started','skipped','cancelled') AND ((d.dependencyType IN ('finish_to_start','blocking') AND p.status NOT IN ('complete','skipped','cancelled')) OR (d.dependencyType='start_to_start' AND p.status='not_started') OR (d.dependencyType='finish_to_finish' AND :requestedStatus2='complete' AND p.status NOT IN ('complete','skipped','cancelled')))

options.message: This task cannot change to the requested status until these prerequisite tasks are resolved: {{dependencyCheck[0].blockerNames}}

sql.query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN :requestedStatus<>'complete' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tasks t WHERE t.id=:taskId AND t.workflowId=:workflowId AND t.tenantId=:tenantId AND ((t.requiredSnapshot=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_task_answers a WHERE a.taskId=t.id AND a.tenantId=t.tenantId AND CASE t.answerTypeSnapshot WHEN 'yes_no' THEN a.answerBoolean IS NOT NULL WHEN 'task_status' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(a.answerStatus),'') IS NOT NULL WHEN 'radio' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(a.answerOptionValue),'') IS NOT NULL WHEN 'dropdown_single' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(a.answerOptionValue),'') IS NOT NULL WHEN 'checkbox_multi' THEN JSON_LENGTH(COALESCE(a.answerJson,JSON_ARRAY()))>0 WHEN 'dropdown_multi' THEN JSON_LENGTH(COALESCE(a.answerJson,JSON_ARRAY()))>0 WHEN 'text_short' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(a.answerText),'') IS NOT NULL WHEN 'text_long' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(a.answerText),'') IS NOT NULL ELSE 0 END)) OR (t.attachmentRequirement='required' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_documents d WHERE d.taskId=t.id AND d.tenantId=t.tenantId)))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS UNSIGNED) allowed

sql.query: UPDATE tbl_tasks SET status=:status,startedDate=CASE WHEN :status2='in_progress' THEN COALESCE(startedDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE startedDate END,completedDate=CASE WHEN :status3='complete' THEN COALESCE(completedDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE NULL END,completedByUserId=CASE WHEN :status4='complete' THEN :userId ELSE NULL END,modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,rowVersion=rowVersion+1 WHERE id=:id AND workflowId=:workflowId AND tenantId=:tenantId

UPDATE tbl_workflow_stages ws SET ws.status=(SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(t.id)=0 THEN 'not_started' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.status NOT IN ('complete','skipped','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN 'complete' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.status NOT IN ('complete','skipped','cancelled') AND t.dueDate<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 THEN 'overdue' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.status='external_hold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 THEN 'external_hold' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.status='internal_hold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 THEN 'internal_hold' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('in_progress','complete') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 THEN 'in_progress' ELSE 'not_started' END FROM tbl_tasks t WHERE t.workflowStageId=ws.id AND t.tenantId=ws.tenantId),ws.startedDate=CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_tasks t WHERE t.workflowStageId=ws.id AND t.tenantId=ws.tenantId AND t.status IN ('in_progress','complete','internal_hold','external_hold'))>0 THEN COALESCE(ws.startedDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE ws.startedDate END,ws.completedDate=CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_tasks t WHERE t.workflowStageId=ws.id AND t.tenantId=ws.tenantId AND t.status NOT IN ('complete','skipped','cancelled'))=0 THEN COALESCE(ws.completedDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE NULL END,ws.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ws.id=(SELECT x.workflowStageId FROM tbl_tasks x WHERE x.id=:taskId AND x.tenantId=:tenantId) AND ws.tenantId=:tenantId2
